title: Official Fair Play Award Winners: MEGA EVENT - Annual Carnival 2026
body: Dear Participants and Team Members, We are thrilled to announce the official Fair Play Award winners for the sporting events of our mega carnival! These awards recognize the teams that displayed exceptional sportsmanship, integrity, and team spirit throughout the competitions. Following a comprehensive evaluation, here are the official Fair Play recipients for each event: Cycling Winners: Team Creators & Team Royals. Tug of War Winners: Team Creators & Team Dominators. Sack Race Winners: Team Creators & Team Royals. Lemon and Spoon Race Winner: Team Creators. Please note: The second-place Fair Play Award for the Lemon and Spoon Race has been withheld and will not be awarded due to a lack of sportsmanship demonstrated by the remaining competing teams. Thank you to all our teams for their incredible energy and participation. Congratulations to our Fair Play winners for setting a wonderful example of sportsmanship! Best regards, Tournament Organizing Committee

title: Women's Lemon & Spoon Race Results Under Review
body: Dear Participants, Please be informed that the official results for the Women's Category of the Lemon & Spoon Race are currently being withheld. To ensure absolute fairness and accuracy, the final standings are undergoing a professional review. We are thoroughly checking the event recordings and judge tallies to resolve any discrepancies. The verified results will be announced shortly. We appreciate your patience and understanding as we ensure the integrity of the competition. Best regards, Tournament Organizing Committee

title: LEMON AND SPOON RACE
body: The second-place Fair Play Award for the Lemon and Spoon Race has been rescinded due to a lack of sportsmanship demonstrated by the two other teams.

title: Mission Possible 2026 - Season Begins!
body: The wait is over. Mission Possible 2026 kicks off on 4th June at RRC with Basketball. Three teams, twelve events, one champion. Stay tuned for live scores, results, and updates right here.
